```{r}
library(MicrobiomeStat)


## 0. Fix species table orientation -------------------------------
## species_filtered1 is samples-in-rows with barcodes in column "FREG1_Barcode".
## LinDA needs features-in-rows, samples-in-columns.
sp_df <- as.data.frame(species_filtered1)
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(sp_df$FREG1_Barcode)))   # error early if dup barcodes
rownames(sp_df) <- sp_df$FREG1_Barcode
sp_df$FREG1_Barcode <- NULL
species_mat <- t(as.matrix(sp_df))                 # rows = species, cols = barcodes

stopifnot(is.numeric(species_mat))                 # catch accidental char coercion
cat("species_mat:", nrow(species_mat), "features x",
    ncol(species_mat), "samples\n")

## 1. Combined per-barcode metadata --------------------------------
food_thosai <- food_data %>%
  transmute(FREG1_Barcode = as.character(Participant_ID),
            Idli_Thosai   = as.numeric(Idli_Thosai))

meta <- metadata_diabete %>%
  mutate(FREG1_Barcode = as.character(FREG1_Barcode),
         BMI          = DBI14_Weight / (DBI13_Height/100)^2,   # assumes height in cm
         FREG7_Gender = factor(FREG7_Gender),
         FREG8_Age    = as.numeric(FREG8_Age),
         HbA1c        = as.numeric(DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent),
         FREG5_Ethnic_Group = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group)) %>%
  inner_join(food_thosai, by = "FREG1_Barcode")

cat("Rows after join:", nrow(meta), "\n")

## 2. Per-group LinDA dose-response --------------------------------
run_group <- function(grp) {
  m <- meta %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == grp,
           !is.na(Idli_Thosai), !is.na(FREG8_Age),
           !is.na(FREG7_Gender), !is.na(BMI), !is.na(HbA1c))
  m <- as.data.frame(m)                          # drop tibble (rownames work)

  keep <- base::intersect(m$FREG1_Barcode, colnames(species_mat))
  cat(grp, ": meta n =", nrow(m),
      "| overlap with species table =", length(keep), "\n")
  if (length(keep) == 0) stop("No barcode overlap for group ", grp)

  m    <- m[match(keep, m$FREG1_Barcode), ]
  rownames(m) <- m$FREG1_Barcode
  feat <- species_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]

  fit <- linda(
    feature.dat = feat,
    meta.dat    = m,
    formula     = "~ Idli_Thosai + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c",
    feature.dat.type = "count",                  # "proportion" if MetaPhlAn rel-abund
    prev.filter = 0.10,                          # present in >=10% of THIS group
    is.winsor   = TRUE
  )

  res         <- fit$output$Idli_Thosai
  res$feature <- rownames(res)
  res$ethnic  <- grp
  res$n       <- nrow(m)
  res
}

all_res <- lapply(c("C","I","M"), run_group)

## 3. Pull Bifidobacterium across the 3 groups ---------------------
bifido <- do.call(rbind, all_res) %>%
  filter(grepl("Bifidobacterium", feature, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  select(ethnic, feature, n, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj) %>%
  arrange(feature, ethnic)

print(bifido)

## 4. Optional: full significant hits per group -------------------
sig <- do.call(rbind, all_res) %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  select(ethnic, feature, n, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, pvalue, padj) %>%
  arrange(ethnic, padj)

print(sig)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tibble)

pal <- c(Chinese = "#999999", Indian = "#D55E00", Malay = "#0072B2")

## --- Build plotting df: genus-summed Bifido relative abundance ----
rel <- sweep(species_mat, 2, colSums(species_mat), "/")   # skip if already proportion
bifido_rows <- grep("Bifidobacterium", rownames(rel), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
bifido_sum  <- colSums(rel[bifido_rows, , drop = FALSE])

plot_df <- tibble(FREG1_Barcode = names(bifido_sum),
                  Bifido = as.numeric(bifido_sum)) %>%
  inner_join(meta, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  mutate(ethnic = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group, levels = c("C","I","M"),
                         labels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay")))

pseudo <- min(plot_df$Bifido[plot_df$Bifido > 0]) / 2   # for log axis

## --- Figure 1: dose-response overlay ------------------------------
p_dose <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(Idli_Thosai, Bifido + pseudo,
                              color = ethnic, fill = ethnic)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.30, size = 1.3,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.4, height = 0)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) + scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(x = "Idli/Thosai intake (g/day)",
       y = expression(log[10]~"Bifidobacterium relative abundance"),
       color = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Bifidobacterium dose-response to Idli/Thosai intake by ethnicity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
p_dose
#ggsave("bifido_doseresponse.pdf", p_dose, width = 7, height = 5)

## --- Figure 2: forest plot of adjusted LinDA slopes ---------------
fp_df <- do.call(rbind, all_res) %>%
  filter(grepl("Bifidobacterium", feature, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(lo = log2FoldChange - 1.96 * lfcSE,
         hi = log2FoldChange + 1.96 * lfcSE,
         sig = ifelse(padj < 0.05, "padj<0.05", "ns"),
         ethnic = factor(ethnic, levels = c("C","I","M"),
                         labels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay")))

p_forest <- ggplot(fp_df, aes(log2FoldChange, feature, color = ethnic)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, shape = sig),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("padj<0.05" = 16, "ns" = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Adjusted log2 fold-change per g/day Idli/Thosai",
       y = NULL, color = NULL, shape = NULL,
       title = "Adjusted Idli/Thosai-Bifidobacterium association by ethnicity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
p_forest
#ggsave("bifido_forest.pdf", p_forest, width = 7.5, height = 4)
```

```{r}
## Genus-summed Bifido as a single feature, per group, adjusted
rel <- sweep(species_mat, 2, colSums(species_mat), "/")   # skip if already proportion
bifido_rows <- grep("Bifidobacterium", rownames(species_mat), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
bifido_genus <- colSums(species_mat[bifido_rows, , drop = FALSE])   # raw counts summed

genus_test <- function(grp) {
  m <- meta %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == grp,
           !is.na(Idli_Thosai), !is.na(FREG8_Age),
           !is.na(FREG7_Gender), !is.na(BMI), !is.na(HbA1c)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  keep <- base::intersect(m$FREG1_Barcode, names(bifido_genus))
  m <- m[match(keep, m$FREG1_Barcode), ]; rownames(m) <- m$FREG1_Barcode
  feat <- rbind(Bifidobacterium = bifido_genus[keep],
                .dummy          = bifido_genus[keep])   # linda needs >1 row; ignore .dummy
  fit <- linda(feature.dat = feat, meta.dat = m,
               formula = "~ Idli_Thosai + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c",
               feature.dat.type = "count", prev.filter = 0, is.winsor = TRUE)
  out <- fit$output$Idli_Thosai["Bifidobacterium", ]
  out$ethnic <- grp; out
}

do.call(rbind, lapply(c("C","I","M"), genus_test))
```

```{r}
run_bifido_model <- function(ethnic_group, species_name) {
  
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == ethnic_group) %>%
    select(
      species_abundance = all_of(species_name),
      Idli_Thosai_log,
      FREG8_Age,
      FREG7_Gender,
      BMI,
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(species_abundance),
      !is.na(Idli_Thosai_log),
      !is.na(FREG8_Age),
      !is.na(FREG7_Gender),
      !is.na(BMI),
      !is.na(DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent)
    )
  
  # skip if too few samples or species has no variation
  if (nrow(dat) < 20) return(NULL)
  if (sd(dat$species_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- lm(
    species_abundance ~ Idli_Thosai_log + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent,
    data = dat
  )
  
  result <- tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "Idli_Thosai_log") %>%
    mutate(
      Ethnicity = ethnic_group,
      Species = species_name,
      N = nrow(dat)
    )
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
idli_bifido_results <- expand.grid(
  Ethnicity = c("C", "I", "M"),
  Species = bifido_species,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(Ethnicity, Species) {
    run_bifido_model(Ethnicity, Species)
  }) %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    Direction = case_when(
      estimate > 0 & p_adj < 0.05 ~ "Positive significant",
      estimate < 0 & p_adj < 0.05 ~ "Negative significant",
      estimate > 0 ~ "Positive non-significant",
      estimate < 0 ~ "Negative non-significant",
      TRUE ~ "No direction"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Ethnicity, p_adj)

idli_bifido_results
```

```{r}
    title = "Within-ethnicity association between Idli/Thosai intake and Bifidobacterium species",
```

```{r}
run_total_bifido_model <- function(ethnic_group) {
  
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == ethnic_group) %>%
    select(
      Bifido_total_log,
      Idli_Thosai_log,
      FREG8_Age,
      FREG7_Gender,
      BMI,
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  fit <- lm(
    Bifido_total_log ~ Idli_Thosai_log + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent,
    data = dat
  )
  
  tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "Idli_Thosai_log") %>%
    mutate(
      Ethnicity = ethnic_group,
      N = nrow(dat)
    )
}

total_bifido_results <- map_dfr(
  c("C", "I", "M"),
  run_total_bifido_model
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    Direction = ifelse(estimate > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Ethnicity,
    N,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value,
    p_adj,
    Direction
  )

total_bifido_results
```

```{r}
make_partial_residual_data <- function(ethnic_group) {
  
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == ethnic_group) %>%
    select(
      FREG1_Barcode,
      Bifido_total_log,
      Idli_Thosai_log,
      FREG8_Age,
      FREG7_Gender,
      BMI,
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  # Remove covariate effects from Bifidobacterium
  fit_y <- lm(
    Bifido_total_log ~ FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent,
    data = dat
  )
  
  # Remove covariate effects from Idli/Thosai
  fit_x <- lm(
    Idli_Thosai_log ~ FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent,
    data = dat
  )
  
  dat %>%
    mutate(
      Bifido_adjusted_residual = resid(fit_y),
      Idli_Thosai_adjusted_residual = resid(fit_x),
      Ethnicity = ethnic_group
    )
}

partial_df <- map_dfr(
  c("C", "I", "M"),
  make_partial_residual_data
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# Make sure ethnicity and gender are factors
df <- df %>%
  filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C", "I", "M")) %>%
  mutate(
    FREG5_Ethnic_Group = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group, levels = c("C", "I", "M")),
    FREG7_Gender = factor(FREG7_Gender)
  )

# Full interaction model
fit_interaction <- lm(
  Bifido_total_log ~ Idli_Thosai_log * FREG5_Ethnic_Group +
    FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent,
  data = df
)

summary(fit_interaction)

interaction_results <- tidy(fit_interaction)
```

```{r}
run_consumer_model <- function(ethnic_group) {
  
  dat <- df_consumer %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == ethnic_group) %>%
    select(
      Bifido_total_log,
      Idli_Thosai_consumer,
      FREG8_Age,
      FREG7_Gender,
      BMI,
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  if (length(unique(dat$Idli_Thosai_consumer)) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- lm(
    Bifido_total_log ~ Idli_Thosai_consumer +
      FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent,
    data = dat
  )
  
  tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "Idli_Thosai_consumerConsumer") %>%
    mutate(
      Ethnicity = ethnic_group,
      N = nrow(dat),
      N_consumer = sum(dat$Idli_Thosai_consumer == "Consumer"),
      N_nonconsumer = sum(dat$Idli_Thosai_consumer == "Non-consumer")
    )
}

consumer_results <- map_dfr(
  c("C", "I", "M"),
  run_consumer_model
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    Direction = ifelse(estimate > 0, "Higher in consumers", "Lower in consumers")
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# 1. Prepare metadata
# ============================================================

metadata_simple <- metadata_diabete %>%
  mutate(
    BMI = DBI14_Weight / (DBI13_Height / 100)^2
  ) %>%
  select(
    FREG1_Barcode,
    FREG5_Ethnic_Group,
    FREG7_Gender,
    FREG8_Age,
    DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent,
    BMI
  )

# ============================================================
# 2. Prepare food data
# ============================================================

food_simple <- food_data %>%
  rename(FREG1_Barcode = Participant_ID)

# food columns
food_cols <- base::setdiff(colnames(food_simple), "FREG1_Barcode")

# species columns
species_cols <- base::setdiff(colnames(species_filtered1), "FREG1_Barcode")

# ============================================================
# 3. Merge data
# ============================================================

df_all <- species_filtered1 %>%
  inner_join(food_simple, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  inner_join(metadata_simple, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C", "I", "M")) %>%
  mutate(
    FREG5_Ethnic_Group = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group, levels = c("C", "I", "M")),
    FREG7_Gender = factor(FREG7_Gender)
  )

table(df_all$FREG5_Ethnic_Group)
```
```{r}
df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(food_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))
```
```{r}
# log-transform food variables only
df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(food_cols), ~ log1p(.x), .names = "log_{.col}"))

food_log_cols <- paste0("log_", food_cols)
```
```{r}
run_one_association <- function(data, ethnic_group, food_var, species_var) {
  
  dat <- data %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == ethnic_group) %>%
    transmute(
      y = .data[[species_var]],
      x = .data[[food_var]],
      Age = FREG8_Age,
      Gender = FREG7_Gender,
      BMI = BMI,
      HbA1c = DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  # skip small sample size
  if (nrow(dat) < 30) return(NULL)
  
  # skip if food has no variation
  if (sd(dat$x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # skip if species has no variation
  if (sd(dat$y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # skip if too few food consumers
  # because log food > 0 means original food intake > 0
  if (sum(dat$x > 0, na.rm = TRUE) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  # skip if species is almost always zero
  if (sum(dat$y > 0, na.rm = TRUE) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- lm(
    y ~ x + Age + Gender + BMI + HbA1c,
    data = dat
  )
  
  tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "x") %>%
    mutate(
      Ethnicity = ethnic_group,
      Food = str_remove(food_var, "^log_"),
      Species = species_var,
      N = nrow(dat),
      N_food_positive = sum(dat$x > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      N_species_positive = sum(dat$y > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}
```

```{r}
foods_of_interest <- c("log_Idli_Thosai", "log_Chapati")

run_food_total_bifido <- function(data, ethnic_group, food_var) {
  
  dat <- data %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == ethnic_group) %>%
    transmute(
      y = Bifido_total_log,
      x = .data[[food_var]],
      Age = FREG8_Age,
      Gender = FREG7_Gender,
      BMI = BMI,
      HbA1c = DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  if (nrow(dat) < 30) return(NULL)
  if (sd(dat$x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (sd(dat$y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (sum(dat$x > 0, na.rm = TRUE) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- lm(y ~ x + Age + Gender + BMI + HbA1c, data = dat)
  
  broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "x") %>%
    mutate(
      Ethnicity = ethnic_group,
      Food = stringr::str_remove(food_var, "^log_"),
      N = nrow(dat),
      N_food_positive = sum(dat$x > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}
```
